title: Grammar: Synthesis and stance: attribute, paraphrase, compare, then evaluate
subtitle: B2 · Unit 12: B2 · TCF writing Task 3: compare two sources and take a position

steps.title: Synthesis and stance: attribute, paraphrase, compare, then evaluate
steps.body: Task 3 asks you to compare two viewpoints and give your own position. A reliable order is: identify each source's central point, show one convergence or difference, then state your view with a reason. Use selon le premier texte / le second fait valoir to keep attribution clear. Paraphrase the idea rather than replacing a few words in a copied sentence. Contrast connectors must reflect the relationship: tandis que compares; cependant introduces a limitation; en outre adds a point. Your conclusion should answer the prompt and not introduce an unrelated claim.

steps.title: Synthesis and stance: attribute, paraphrase, compare, then evaluate
rows: Attribute
selon / le texte fait valoir
Selon le premier texte, l'accès doit être prioritaire.
According to the first text, access should be a priority.
Converge
les deux textes s'accordent sur
Les deux textes s'accordent sur la nécessité d'évaluer le coût.
Both texts agree that cost needs to be assessed.
Contrast
tandis que / cependant
Le premier défend un essai, tandis que le second demande plus de données.
The first supports a trial, whereas the second asks for more data.
Paraphrase
restate the idea in new wording
Le texte souhaite que les résultats soient rendus accessibles.
The text wants the results to be made accessible.
Position
à mon sens + reason
À mon sens, un essai limité serait préférable.
In my view, a limited trial would be preferable.

steps.prompt: Which phrase clearly attributes an idea?
options: On ne peut jamais dire que…
Il est évident pour tous que…
Le premier document fait valoir que…
steps.explain: This phrase identifies the source of the claim.

steps.prompt: What is the purpose of paraphrasing?
options: Copy its sentence with one word changed
Restate the source's meaning in your own wording
steps.explain: A paraphrase preserves meaning with new wording.

steps.prompt: Which connector adds a point rather than contrasts?
steps.explain: En outre adds information; the others often signal contrast.
